brief: ULTRACODE dispatch on W1-01 (world: province terrain, regions, roads, the crossing) after r1 3.1/10 and r2 3.5/10
outputs_expected: THE CROSSING grade/cut fixes + real deck span structures
locomotion: max walkable slope, fall damage, water degradation (S25)
harness camera() throws on bad call
CONSUMPTION proof for every model shipped
findings: BASELINE CONFIRMED (probe critic-w1-01-r2-loco.mjs re-run at HEAD): L1 70.63 deg walked at full stick, state WALK; L2 150 m drop HP unchanged; L3 8.28 m water -> 1.1 m/s but stamina 120->120.

game/data/combat/hitgeometry.json was transiently invalid JSON (another agent mid-edit) and broke every harness probe; it self-resolved. Concurrent-agent breakage of the shared tree is a recurring hazard for probes.
hazards.json IS loaded by engine.js:3117 into data.hazards and read by NOTHING else -> RI-MTH07 CONSUMPTION failure, same class as deck_spans.
engine.camera(pose): unknown keys like {yaw,pitch,arm} fall through to the override branch and freeze the camera at cur.pos/cur.look. Needs a closed key vocabulary that throws.

field.heightAt() is the single ground surface for collision, mesh, audits. Signature landforms must go through it. _applyRoads blends ground to deck over hw..3.2*hw - that IS the earth berm the critic measured.
engine._settleWorld() (engine.js:1330) snaps p.pos[1] = field.heightAt() every frame with no vertical integration at all -> that is why there is no fall and no max slope.
13 ONLY-HERE ids live in tools/world/build-regions.mjs only_here:{id,instances} and are copied into regions.json; nothing places them.

DONE: RI-WLD04 M19 now measures 13/13 in the running world (signatureAudit()): all 13 ONLY-HERE elements placed at declared counts, 0 instances outside their own region. 7 of 13 are LANDFORM (max ground delta: flute spire +25.2 m, comb cliff +12.8 m, petrified bole +9.5 m, hull +8.2 m, kiln +7.9 m, crater -8.9 m, root causeway +2.6 m) so they are in field.heightAt() and therefore in collision, mesh, slope histogram and every audit.

ROAD: deck spans are now STRUCTURES. field.setRoads marks span segments; _applyRoads returns a hard deck within hw+0.5 and leaves the ground under it alone; province._spans builds slab+parapets+piers+arches; field.onDeckAt/clampToDeck give a parapet you cannot walk off the side of.

ROAD SOLVE rewritten: cut is now constrained against corridorMaxGround sampled at 3 m along and across (the round-2 sampling defect), and the profile is a single DILATION of the lower bound so the grade limit cannot be overridden afterwards. Max grade 1.637 (58.6 deg) -> 0.58 (30.1 deg). Max cut 3.62 -> 3.00 at 3 m sampling. Trunk metres: 20,334 carriageway / 763 switchback / 1,492 stair. 15 spans, 1,228 m.
CROSSING after all of it: 55.441 min, 6,644.3 m, mean 1.9976 m/s, 0.177% below 1.6 m/s. All four M2/M3 checks PASS. S17 holds.

S17 NEAR-MISS FOUND AND FIXED: applying RI-WLD10 §4's substrate multiplier to the raster under the road took the crossing to mean 1.9032 m/s with 9.7% of samples below the honesty floor. RI-WLD10 §4's own FIRM row names 'root-wood roads, boardwalk' as FIRM, so field.substrateAt returns FIRM on the carriageway. The hour is distance again.

SLOPE GATE: four instruments tried. per-frame rise (useless at 60 Hz: a wall gives a 3 cm rise), rise+threshold (trips on 0.57 m pad/road step discontinuities, stalled the crossing at 321 m), omnidirectional slopeAt (a road on a 2.4 m embankment reads 40 deg ACROSS a surface flat ALONG it, stalled at 502 m), and finally DIRECTIONAL slope over a 3 m lookahead with the carriageway and bridge decks exempt. That last one works and is the one shipped.

scale-audit: M2-ROAD-CUT-AND-FILL now re-measures from the terrain sub-sampled at 3 m along and across (not read out of roads.json), and SPLITS earth embankment from deck span. Result: cut 3.00 m (was 3.62 at 3 m sampling while the tool reported 3.0), tallest EARTH embankment 6.85 m (was 17.52), tallest deck span 33.34 m over 1,679 m of structure. New check M2b-DECK-SPANS-ARE-STRUCTURES: 15/15 spans read by field.onDeckAt() with >=3.62 m clearance under them (RI-MTH07 consumption).

M1-SETTLEMENT-FLAT regression found and fixed mid-work: dilating from the cut lower bound alone puts the road exactly MAX_CUT below flat ground, which drove a 3 m trench through all eight settlements (23.0 deg). Fixed by taking max(dilation(L), erosion(ground)) - both grade-feasible, so the max is too. Back to 6.8 deg.

camera(): unknown pose keys now THROW with a closed vocabulary [pos, look, fov, mode, lockOn]; pos/look shape and fov range validated; camera({}) is now a pure READ (it used to install an override at the current pose, i.e. asking where the camera was froze it).

HAZARDS: game/src/sim/hazards.js reads hazards.json as the only source of magnitudes. 9 of 19 are ANCHORED on placed signature geometry (kiln domes, comb cliffs, voriplasm, dye vats, boles, welkynd pillars, root arches), 10 are terrain/water/weather conditions. SHELTER table implements RI-WLD11 H3 route/knowledge counters using the region's own ONLY-HERE element: a crater shelters from the salt-storm, the knife-marked stems are the safe path through the thicket, the Imperial road shelters from ridge-exposure.

SIX of the nineteen hazards have damage.kind 'none' by design (RI-WLD11 M57 requires >=6). A health-bar probe cannot measure a VECTOR/GATE/STRANDING firing - that is why round 2's centroid probe read 620->620. They now fire with a consequence (affliction / route_closed) and a hazard_fired event carrying it.

NIGHT: six regions own an emissive signature element; Province.updateSignatureLights() places up to 6 bounded point lights of the region's own glow colour, driven from the same sun elevation the sky uses. An emissive material alone lights nothing around it, which is why round 2's night frames were near-black.

HAZARDS FIRING: 19/19 (reports/hazard-fire.json). Attrition, trap, kill, vector, gate and stranding classes all produce a consequence. TRAP re-arm bug found and fixed (a 16% comb collapse fired 60x/s because the volume re-armed on the next frame while the player was still in it).

M18 rebuilt: 12 MEASURED axes (was 7 measured + 5 dropped). New signature_silhouette (heightAt minus naturalHeightAt on a 12 m lattice) 60/78, architecture_placed (solid signature instances + deck spans) 78/78, hazard UN-DROPPED 78/78. Minimum axes differing across all 78 pairs = 8 (bar 8). fauna/audio/weather still honestly dropped.
Amendment AM-W1-01-01 filed: A7's instrument should state its pass condition on the COLOUR-STRIPPED control, not on 4x4 mean CIELAB. Argues for a harder bar against this piece's own interest.

CONSUMPTION (RI-MTH07): tools/world/consumption.mjs builds the world twice from the same modules the browser loads, once shipped and once with one field perturbed. 9/9 perturbations changed the world across 4 models (signatures.json, traversal.json, hazards.json, roads.json deck_spans). Examples: moving one rock_flute_spire 400 m drops the ground at its old position 434.607 -> 418.307 m; deleting the craters takes M19 stone-wastes 16 -> 0; slope.max_walkable_deg 40 -> 85 takes the climb up a 72 deg face 1.04 -> 2.93 m; salt-storm value 1.2 -> 0.1 takes 90 s of standing from 372 -> 31 HP; deleting deck_spans takes onDeckAt from a deck with 8.01 m of clearance to null and raises the >40 deg shoulder count from 52 to 90 of 248 sampled points.

SLOPE GATE FINAL: directional 1.5 m secant OR slopeAt at a 2.5 m baseline, whichever is greater, uphill only, carriageway and bridge decks exempt. Sweep of 7 faces: gate fires at 42.23/61.30/65.28/71.97 deg; MAX REALISED CLIMB GRADE across the whole sweep is 35.4 deg against the 40 deg bar. Round 2 walked 70.63 deg at full stick.

FALL: 3 m 0 hp, 5 m 10.63 (1.7%), 10 m 132.75 (21.4%), 20 m 525.12 (84.7%), 60 m and 150 m fatal. Round 2's probe stepped 180 frames, which at 19.6 m/s^2 cannot see a 150 m landing (3.91 s = 235 frames) even against a correct implementation.
NIGHT LIGHT PERF: six dynamic point lights took the M17 night pass from 11 s/frame to 3.75 MIN/frame on the software rasteriser. Cut to 2 lamps plus a region-glow-tinted night ambient in sky.js.

Road shoulders re-measured network-wide at 6 m along and 6 offsets across each non-tideway leg (37,506 samples): 1,130 points above 40 deg (3.0%), and 732 of those 1,130 are beside a DECK - i.e. they are the gorge wall the viaduct crosses, not fill the road placed. Only 398 are beside earth road. Round 2 counted 2,537 over-40 shoulder points on an all-earth network.

S24 water census and RI-WLD11 M57 hazard census both still PASS after the substrateAt road-is-FIRM change and the signature landform: area-weighted WCI 0.294 (bar 0.22-0.42), 5 dry regions, 2 bone dry, 19 hazards, 13/13 signatures, 1 KILL, 8 zero-damage.
npm gate (corpus-index --check) and tools/check-data.mjs both pass at 324 indexed data files.

ROAD FINAL (STAIR_GRADE 0.45): network max grade 0.45 = 24.2 deg (round 2: 1.637 = 58.6 deg). THE CROSSING max grade 24.2 deg, max cut 3.00 m at 3 m sampling. Network grade classes: 20,194 m carriageway / 750 m switchback / 1,645 m stair. Tallest EARTH embankment 6.97 m (round 2: 17.52 m). Tallest DECK SPAN 41.17 m over 2,026 m of structure, 15/15 read by field.onDeckAt.

BUG FOUND LATE: the signature landform delta was being added ON TOP of a bridge deck, putting the walkable surface 3 m above the slab the parapet clamps to, and it stalled the offline crossing at 545 m. field.heightAt now returns the deck outright (field._deckY) and never adds groundDelta over it; clampToDeck no longer clamps when the destination is on another deck (two spans overlap where the road doubles back).
Final offline regression after every change: the crossing walks all 588 points, 6,798.3 m, no stall; the slope sweep blocks every face over 40 deg with a max realised climb of 35.4 deg.

Viaduct demonstration: the tallest declared span is stormhold-helstrom, 40.7 m, 287 m long. At its midpoint field.onDeckAt returns a deck at y 93.03 with 34.82 m of clearance to the ground beneath. Two points past the span end onDeckAt is null and the ground is 43.50 m. That is a bridge.

THE GAP IS NOW LOCATED PRECISELY, AND IT IS NOT WHERE ROUND 2 PUT IT. Round 2's remedy was 'the thirteen ONLY-HERE elements do not exist; place them'. They exist now - M19 13/13, 840 instances, 7 of 13 deforming the ground the collision and the mesh share, 36 of 39 sampled instances walked up to. And the colour-stripped day separability moved 30.8% -> 33.3%. The reason is arithmetic: 840 instances over 14.31 km2 is 59 per km2, and M17 samples 3 RANDOM points per region, so the typical frame does not contain one. The ONLY-HERE element is by definition rare; the frame is made of the ORDINARY ground and the ORDINARY flora, and those are still smooth terrain plus canopy/under/rock. A rare landmark cannot move a statistic computed over random frames.
next_step: run `node tools/world/region-dispersion.mjs` once reports/region-shots finishes capturing (it was at 55/117 at hand-off). That produces the raw AND colour-stripped LOO/Fisher for day, night and worst, plus the matched-design comparison against Morrowind, into reports/region-dispersion.json.
notes_for_successor: State at hand-off: signatures (13/13 M19), traversal (slope gate/fall/water/mire), hazards (19/19 firing), roads (spans as structures, grade 0.58 max, cut 3.00 at 3 m sampling), camera refusals, M18 12 axes min 8. OUTSTANDING: (1) region shot pack rebuild + dispersion raw/structure-only for day and night is the last headline measurement - run tools/world/province-shots.mjs --out reports/region-shots then tools/world/critic-w1-01-r2-dispersion.mjs and critic-w1-01-r2-structure.mjs. (2) M36-ROAD-RELIEF is 27.3% against a 30% target and I did not move it - it needs a route change, not a deck change, and route changes risk the pinned leg lengths. (3) No audio anywhere, so RI-WLD04 M20 is still 0 and the audio axis is still honestly dropped. (4) No enemy roster in the province, so RI-AI05/RI-PRG06/M21 remain 0 - that is W1-09's. (5) tools/world/w1-01-r3-probe.mjs is written but had not been run at the time of writing.

headline_numbers.max_walkable_slope: 40.0 deg, declared in game/data/world/traversal.json and read by BOTH sim/traversal.js (the body) and tools/world/scale-audit.mjs S9-NO-FENCES (the passability model) - round 2's thirty-degree disagreement between the two is closed. Seven-face sweep with the final build: the gate fires at 42.23 / 71.51 / 75.41 / 80.55 deg and the MAXIMUM REALISED CLIMB GRADE anywhere in the sweep is 35.4 deg. Round 2 walked a 70.63 deg face at full stick, +10.28 m in 5 s, state WALK.

headline_numbers.crossing_grade_and_cut: max grade 0.45 = 24.2 deg (round 2: 1.637 = 58.6 deg); max cut 3.00 m sub-sampled at 3 m (round 2: 3.62 m while the tool reported 3.0).

headline_numbers.dispersion_day: 39 day frames, 13 regions, chance 7.7%. RAW (4x4 mean CIELAB): LOO 74.4%, Fisher 3.106 — UNCHANGED from round 2 (74.4% / 3.10). COLOUR-STRIPPED (6x4 Sobel edge density + 6x4 luminance layout, z-scored per image): LOO 33.3%, Fisher 1.756 — round 2 was 30.8% / 1.77. THE COLOUR-STRIPPED NUMBER BARELY MOVED. The critic's stated acceptance was >=55%. Morrowind on the same code: RAW 25.6% / 1.417, STRUCTURE 17.9% / 0.868.
headline_numbers.dispersion_night_partial: PARTIAL - the capture was at 60/117 when the session ran out. On the 24 night frames captured (8 regions, chance 12.5%): RAW LOO 62.5% / Fisher 2.084; STRUCTURE LOO 33.3% / Fisher 1.29. Not comparable to round 2's 33.3% night figure, which was 39 frames over 13 regions at chance 7.7%. Finish it with: node tools/world/province-shots.mjs --out reports/region-shots (in flight) then node tools/world/region-dispersion.mjs.

could_not_close: THE HEADLINE: the colour-stripped day LOO is 33.3% against the critic's >=55% acceptance. Placing the thirteen ONLY-HERE elements as real landform was necessary and is done, but it is NOT sufficient, and I can say why with a number: 59 instances per km2 against a 3-random-frames-per-region sample. What the structure-only descriptor reads is the ground and the flora in EVERY frame. The next remedy is therefore per-region GROUND MICRO-RELIEF (hummocks in Blackwood, terraces in the Stone Forest, ripple fields on the tidal flats, crack polygons on the Clay Moor, dune-and-pan on the Stone Wastes) driven off each region's declared `terrain.style`, plus per-region prop ARRANGEMENT (paddies in rows, thicket clustered, hive bare) instead of one jittered lattice for all thirteen. Both touch every frame rather than 840 points. I did not attempt it: it changes field.heightAt everywhere, which means re-verifying the water census, the crossing, the slope histogram and the reachability fill, and then a fresh 117-frame capture - and a half-done terrain change would have been worse than an honest measurement.

M36-ROAD-RELIEF 27.3% against a >=30% target (fail floor 12%). This is a ROUTE property, not a deck property: it counts 500 m road windows with >=15 m of elevation change. Fixing it means re-routing legs through more relief, and every leg's length and sinuosity is pinned to RI-WLD01 §4's table and checked by M4-LEG-TIMES and the crossing's 52-65 min band. I would need a ruling that the declared leg lengths may move before touching it.

RI-WLD04 M20 (audio blind test, 39 clips, >=26/39 to pass) is unrunnable: getWorldStats reports audioMB 0 and there is no audio subsystem in the build at all. The `audio` axis in M18 is still honestly DROPPED for the same reason. This needs a wave assignment, not a W1-01 fix.

RI-AI05, RI-PRG06 and RI-WLD04 M21 all need a placed enemy roster; entitiesLive is still 0 in all thirteen regions. danger_tier 1-5 is still an integer that gates nothing. That is W1-09's roster, and hazards are as far as W1-01 can honestly take regional lethality on its own.
RI-CAM02 M1-M7 belong to W1-06. I fixed the harness surface (camera() now refuses loudly) but did not run the camera item's methods.

The M17 human blind test cannot be taken by me: I built the world, so I am contaminated on every frame. Only a fresh-context critic can produce the human number, and the machine numbers in reports/region-dispersion.json are the substitute, not the thing.

MIRED is aggressive and a critic re-running tools/world/critic-w1-01-r2-loco.mjs will see it. RI-WLD10 §4 says six footfalls on SUCK mires you; I gated it on SUCK WITH WATER IN IT (traversal.json substrate.mire_requires_band = 'W1') and declared the deviation in the file. Set it to 'W0' for the literal reading and roughly a fifth of the province becomes a struggle to cross on foot.

tools/world/critic-w1-01-r2-loco.mjs's L4 travel block reports 'travelRide: no ride is in progress' after every quote. I did not touch travel and it reproduced at HEAD before any of my changes, so it is either a pre-existing sequencing defect in the probe or in the travel surface. Flagged, not fixed.

The viaduct parapet is not airtight. `field.clampToDeck` tested directly holds the body between 3.36 and 3.50 m of the centreline indefinitely (half-width 3.0 + 0.35 kerb), but driven through the full `Traversal.step` loop a body pushing sideways still leaves the tallest span after about 3.5 m and then SLIDES down the valley wall - 44 m laterally, 41.75 m down, no damage, state SLIDE. It is not a void under the viaduct, it is a valley side, so sliding is not obviously wrong; but I could not account for the difference between the direct test and the loop and I am not going to claim a railing I have not proved. tools/../scratchpad/deck.mjs reproduces it.
